response.overview: Good Grace! It's Brendan is a live stand-up recording of one of Ireland's most cherished comedians, captured in front of a full house at the University Concert Hall, Limerick. Released in 2001 on VHS by Beaumex Ltd and directed by Ray McHugh, the tape presents approximately 60 minutes of material across 15 sketches, including Brendan Grace's beloved Bottler routines that made him a household name across Ireland and the wider Irish diaspora.  This is a release for fans of traditional Irish comedy and anyone who grew up watching Brendan Grace on television and stage. The PG certificate makes it suitable for a wide family audience, and the live concert atmosphere — crowd laughter, real timing, genuine energy — gives it warmth that studio recordings rarely match.
response.title: Good Grace It's Brendan!
